answers.Q1_who_holds_the_credential: The runtime, and it differs per provider. config.toml holds references, never secrets.
answers.Q2_does_runtime_self_acquire: No. cliproxy-google has no api_key_env and receives no Authorization header; opencode-go references an env var name and passes it through. No evidence of runtime-side OAuth acquisition.
answers.Q3_does_proxy_handle_auth: Yes for cliproxy-google, whose base_url is the local endpoint http://127.0.0.1:10100/v1.
answers.Q4_can_registry_observe_validity: No. Three obstacles: runtime exposes no credential state, veya holds no credential source by design, and no runtime exists to call.
answers.Q5_must_probe_go_through_runtime: Yes for cliproxy-google (no independent credential, so a bypass cannot distinguish invalid credential from absent passthrough). No for opencode-go.
answers.Q6_who_proves_authenticated: The runtime, via one genuinely completed request. No local evidence can substitute.

third_false_positive_class.verdict: False authentication with no relation to credentials at all — weaker than both classes SF-CRED already fixed.

D3_credential_truthfulness_integration.note: All three are unsatisfiable without a runtime, which is STOP condition 4.

diversity_rules.FD-1: Hicode and Antigravity share FD-GEMINI-UPSTREAM and must not be counted as two independent candidates in one failover chain.
diversity_rules.FD-2: Selection must drop already-failed candidates of the same fault domain first; if none remain, report DOMAIN_EXHAUSTED rather than retrying within the domain.
diversity_rules.FD-3: Receipts must record fault_domain_id; repeated failures within one domain must not accumulate as independent failover successes.
diversity_rules.FD-4: A shared-domain candidate expresses preference in preferred_executor, never exclusivity.
